title: How different IQ pirates split the treasure

lines.tts: [intrigued] Three pirates. One pile of gold. Here's how different IQs split it.
lines.text: Three pirates. One pile of gold. Here's how different IQs split it.

lines.tts: [dry] Now nobody has gold. Or teeth.
lines.text: Now nobody has gold. Or teeth.

lines.tts: [slow, counting] One for you... one for me... one for you...
lines.text: One for you... one for me... one for you...

lines.tts: [calm, clever] I'll split it into two piles. You pick first.
lines.text: I'll split it into two piles. You pick first.

lines.tts: [building] Now her split has to be perfectly fair... because he'll grab the bigger pile.
lines.text: Now her split has to be perfectly fair... because he'll grab the bigger pile.

lines.tts: That's 'I cut, you choose.' The fairest way to split anything: treasure, chores... even a business.
lines.text: That's 'I cut, you choose.' The fairest way to split anything: treasure, chores... even a business.

lines.tts: [squawking, cheeky] And one for the PARROT!
